breakdown.description: The Fox equation is written in reciprocal absolute temperature, so the component T_g values must be converted to K.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly converts the component T_g values to Kelvin (T_g,A = 373 K and T_g,B = 293 K) and explicitly states that the Fox equation calculation is performed using temperatures in Kelvin. This directly addresses the inconsistency where the incomplete prompt incorrectly applied the Fox equation using Celsius values instead of absolute temperatures.
